question: Which of the following diseases is a potential contender for worldwide eradication?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Polio.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __ Key Points__

__
 
• **Polio** is a potential contender for **worldwide eradication** because it is a **vaccine-preventable disease** and there are effective vaccines available.
 
• The **World Health Organization **(WHO) has been leading the global effort to **eradicate polio **since **1988,** and significant progress has been made in reducing the number of cases worldwide.
 
• **Tuberculosis, measles, and malaria** are not currently considered potential contenders for worldwide eradication because they are more difficult to **control and eliminate** due to various factors such as **drug resistance, lack of effective vaccines,** and **complex transmission patterns.**
 
• However, efforts are still being made to reduce the burden of these diseases through various strategies such as **improved diagnostics, treatment, and prevention measures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tuberculosis** is a** bacterial infection** that primarily affects the **lungs** but can also affect other parts of the body.

 
 
• It is a major cause of** illness** and **death** worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Measles** is a highly contagious** viral **infection.
 
 
• It can cause serious complications such as** pneumonia, brain damage, and death,** and it is still a major cause of death among young children in many parts of the world.
 
 
 
• **Malaria** is a parasitic infection that is transmitted by **mosquitoes**, and it can cause **fever, chills, and flu-like symptoms**, and in severe cases, it can lead to organ failure and death.
 
 
• It is a major public health problem in many **tropical and subtropical **regions of the world.
